findings.issue_text: Membership lookup is skipped when an organization has no child teams, omitting individual bookings from organization-level members even though teamIds includes the organization itself
getAuthorizationConditions() always returns a truthy Prisma.Sql value, including 1=0, making the filter-only and final fallback branches unreachable

goldens.comment: In getBaseConditions(), the else if (filterConditions) and final else branches are unreachable. This is because getAuthorizationConditions() always returns a non-null Prisma.Sql object, making authConditions always truthy, which means only the first two if/else if conditions are ever evaluated.

Fetching userIdsFromOrg only when teamsFromOrg.length > 0 can exclude org-level members for orgs without child teams; consider deriving from teamIds (which includes orgId) or removing the guard so org-only orgs still include member user bookings.

per_golden_matches.golden_comment: Fetching userIdsFromOrg only when teamsFromOrg.length > 0 can exclude org-level members for orgs without child teams; consider deriving from teamIds (which includes orgId) or removing the guard so org-only orgs still include member user bookings.
per_golden_matches.matched_candidate: Membership lookup is skipped when an organization has no child teams, omitting individual bookings from organization-level members even though teamIds includes the organization itself
per_golden_matches.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies the exact same problem as the golden comment: when an organization has no child teams (teamsFromOrg.length === 0), the membership lookup is skipped, which means organization-level members' bookings are omitted even though teamIds includes the organization itself. Both comments point to the same bug where the guard condition incorrectly excludes org-only organizations from having their member bookings included.
